parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must transfer an information request to the appropriate authority within five days of receipt.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform transfers requests to the correct authority within five days.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling information requests.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is specific to the transfer timeline for information requests.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must provide requested information within thirty days of receipt, unless exempted.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the platform provides information within thirty days or rejects it with valid reasons.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling information requests.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation applies to the time limit for responding to information requests.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must provide information within forty-eight hours if it concerns the life or liberty of a person.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform provides information within forty-eight hours for life or liberty-related requests.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling sensitive information requests.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is specific to urgent information requests related to life or liberty.

parsed_entries.requirement: Failure to respond within the specified period is deemed a refusal of the request.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the platform treats delayed responses as refusals.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling information requests.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation applies to the consequences of not responding within the time limit.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must inform applicants immediately about the transfer of an application to another authority.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform informs applicants about the transfer of their request.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to public authorities handling information requests.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is specific to the notification requirement for transferred requests.
